authority_note: This is a GPT-Knowledge navigation projection derived from the canonical LBE document intent manifest and documentation router. It does not replace machine governance, current source/runtime evidence, or the active acceptance gate.

coverage.projection_rule: Every canonical documentation area must remain represented; live/current authority classes must stay directly discoverable; reference, research, and history must remain visibly non-current authority.

areas.title: Live Owners
areas.authority: Current human-readable owners and documentation routers; machine governance and runtime evidence still outrank projections.

areas.title: Governance
areas.authority: Cross-cutting progression and implementation rules; machine gate remains execution authority.

areas.title: Acceptance
areas.authority: Active machine-selected acceptance authority plus preserved closed proof. Historical gates are not current authority.

areas.title: Design
areas.authority: Architecture and product design intent; not proof of runtime behavior.

areas.title: Contracts
areas.authority: Named current technical contracts and registries; not status reports.

areas.title: Reference
areas.authority: Supporting product/external/technical evidence only; never acceptance proof by itself.

areas.title: Research
areas.authority: Exploratory comparison/research material. Conclusions become durable only after promotion into a canonical owner document.

areas.title: History
areas.authority: Closed evidence and superseded records retained for provenance; never current authority unless explicitly reactivated by governance.

areas.title: Preserved Unused Material
areas.authority: Canonical preservation and recovery index only; never live source/runtime/governance/documentation authority.
